shared.title: Move-In Week
shared.theme: Half house, half arena: seven days to make strangers a household, then three bouts that test it.
shared.question: Can four strangers make Sakura Lane a home in a week, and still stand together when the arena sorts them?
shared.builds_to: The placement tournament at Chikara Battle Arena (Days 6 to 7) and the night the results come home.
shared.ending_shape: bittersweet, one crack: the house holds, each housemate walks into a different class on Monday, and one moment of friction stings without becoming a wound

hidden.turning_point: Day 7 results night. PCs placed together in one specialization; housemates split (Tatsuya Strike, Mio Support, Shin Investigation, Sunny Media). Crack default: Ayame jabs Sunny ('consolation prize') within a PC's earshot in the gallery; Sunny looks at that PC before answering. Fallback, checked Day 7 morning: if no PC has had a scene with Sunny beyond her arrival, use the friction candidate (bible 4.1) for the housemate the PCs got closest to.
hidden.notes: PENDING (turn ops need turn >=1): add three act-deviation ops for act 1 to the first commit-turn payload (turn 2): personal marks per PC; beats on the world clock, not skips; about 60 turns in two arcs instead of about 45. STRUCTURE: about 60 turns in two arcs: A1 Move-In (Days 1-5, ~30), A2 Placement (Days 6-7 + results, ~30). Stakes personal: Shimazu's Day 3 warning stays background. BEATS ON THE WORLD CLOCK, not skips: Mio comes down the next time any PC is in or near the kitchen; Sunny's taxi arrives the first turn after noon wherever the PCs are (they hear the luggage); skips only per the agency rules. SPLITS: at most 3 scenes run at once (A/B/C); a 4th holds until its player acts; habit: an NPC asks two PCs along, never a director merge. HOUSE REACHES OUT: Pulse chore rota, dinner list, group chat, housemate messages; if ignored, the world moves on (dinner happens, Tatsuya saves plates). TUTORIAL: one reminder Day 4-5 if open; Tatsuya raises it Day 6 morning; then the PCs' choice stands. TOURNAMENT: every team fights all three bouts (placement, not knockout); Voyage hears this as a plain fact at the briefing (record the fact then). Bout budgets taper: R1 <=4, R2 <=6, Final <=8, one housemate gallery/bay beat between bouts; housemates' own bouts offscreen. Opponents stay as the bible has them; a PC power that hard-counters one is an earned early win, no second phase. PERSONAL MARKS: each PC gets one, drawn from their standout moment in Voyage's bout output, delivered as an ignorable offer (instructor note, elective invite) by existing staff only, never a stat. SEEDING: step-1 tells for Mio, Sunny, Shin, plus Shimazu's look at Yuto on Day 4; nothing for Arimura or Ayame. SPOTLIGHT: organic; correct when `spotlight` shows a PC at 0. Session zero: combat 3, social 3, mystery 2, exploration 1; ending hope bittersweet.
